answer:
CPython 中定义 `PyObject_Malloc` 的源文件是：

[`Objects/obmalloc.c`](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/main/Objects/obmalloc.c)

该文件包含 `PyObject_Malloc(size_t size)` 的实现；声明则位于 [`Include/pymem.h`](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/main/Include/pymem.h)。
